title: Niagara Falls in winter
subtitle: Snow, ice and mist beside the falls, an evening performance, then blue water beneath a clear winter sky.

cover.alt: Blue-green Horseshoe Falls curving beneath a clear sky, with snow and ice along the bank.
cover.caption: Blue-green Horseshoe Falls curving beneath a clear sky, with snow and ice along the bank.

chapters.title: Snow beside the falls
paragraphs: Mist and snow soften the falls and riverside paths. By evening, the view turns towards the town’s lights.

chapters.title: An evening at the stage
paragraphs: The evening moves indoors, through theatre balconies, coloured stage light and a cheering crowd, before a final look up at the glass atrium.

chapters.title: The falls beneath a blue sky
paragraphs: Clearer weather brings blue water, bright snow and views of the town above the frozen riverbanks.
